name: fo-country-by-country-reporting
description: Screen Faroese multinational groups for country-by-country reporting and notification obligations in 2026. Distinguish prior-year consolidated revenue, ultimate-parent and local filing, surrogate relief, year-end notification and the twelve-month report deadline. Compile jurisdiction totals, constituent entities, activities and explanatory information while keeping cash tax, current accrued tax, permanent-establishment fields and consolidation eliminations distinct. Use for Faroese CbCR, foreign-parent group reporting, local filing, surrogate-parent notifications and the DKK 5.6 billion threshold. This Guide prepares an obligation assessment and reporting workpaper; it does not compute transfer prices or minimum tax. Actual exchange relationships, foreign-currency threshold cases and current template transmission still need verification. Independent AI review accepted partial draft publication; professional attestation is pending.
